visual_logic.color_palette: Dark slate-blue with a creamy-yellow underbelly and a subtle 'frill' of dark clay scales along the spine, extending horizontally from head to tail.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Thin 'needle-stripes' of Phosphatic Gold running horizontally along its full lateral side flank.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Extremely long, gavial-like snout; delicate and needle-thin, oriented perfectly parallel to the frame edge in a strict profile view.
visual_logic.texture: Small, overlapping diamond-shaped clay scales; glossy black eyes facing laterally.
visual_logic.environment: Vibrant blue water with massive white 'clay' splashes moved entirely into the background and outer perimeter layers to ensure a completely unobstructed silhouette path.

pose: The specialized mosasaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original sudden lateral head-snap action is stabilized into a straight, level cruising path, allowing the hyper-elongated needle-thin snout, streamlined torso, flippers, and tail to extend end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system for precise top-by-bottom length analysis.
